name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: Features: exact variant watches, combined availability and price targets, stock and price insights, actionable Watchlist summaries, collection purchase plans, budgets, direct collection adding, archiving and Undo. UI/UX: Store-inspired Browse, collection preview cards, clearer alert settings, and Activity pagination. Fixes: verified collection saves, preserved purchase records and dialog focus, accurate variant prices, and current-schema standalone validation. Security: stronger password hashing, strict host validation, restricted service identities, and hardened Docker isolation. Upgrade: validated safety backup before schema v11; format-v7 recovery exports. See RELEASE_NOTES.md for all changes since 1.0.0.
